Emma / team — quick technical notes from my side after skimming the blueprint:
- Our runtime supports fp16 and 4-bit quantization. For 4-bit we default to int4 kernels that require CUDA compute capability >= 8.6 (A100s and H100s are fine; older V100s will fall back and suffer perf).
- KV cache retention: default is LRU with explicit prefix cache API. We'll need to map your session IDs to our prefix keys; we can provide a small adapter shim if QB wants to keep their session namespace.
- Model routing: we can express fallback policies via a policy JSON; if primary variant is missing we will route to the configured fallback and attach a header X-Model-Fallback. We will measure tail latency under failover.

Questions for you:
1) AMI id and the user account we should use to consume the image.
2) Does the AMI include any custom drivers (e.g., patched CUDA, NCCL)? If so, we need the exact versions.
3) Any E2E tests you want prioritized (e.g., streaming vs non-streaming response correctness).

Attaching a short diff of our runbook with suggestions: rbw-runbook-diff.patch (stub).

Thanks — can join Friday
Marissa
Director, Integrations | Redwood Inference
